beats.narration: If your steering wheel only shakes at highway speed, that's not random.
beats.visualPrompt: Interior POV shot from the driver's seat looking at the steering wheel on an open highway, subtle vibration blur cue on the wheel rim, daylight, static-mounted camera.

beats.narration: Smooth around town, then a vibration kicks in around 55 to 65 — and gets worse the faster you go.
beats.visualPrompt: Exterior side-tracking shot of a sedan accelerating on a highway on-ramp, speed blur on the wheel/tire only (rest of frame sharp); cut to a speedometer needle climbing past 55.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2.5s sub-shots before real generation to satisfy the 1.5-2.5s visual-change cadence.

beats.narration: One clue: it's the wheel and tire, not the brakes — an out-of-balance tire or a bent rim.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a wheel and tire assembly on a balancing machine in a shop bay, small clip-on weights visible along the rim edge, slow push-in, no hands in frame.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (wide + macro push-in) before real generation.

beats.narration: Only shakes when you brake? Different problem — a warped rotor. Shakes at speed no matter what? This is it.
beats.visualPrompt: Split-style comparison cutaway: one side a brake rotor with visible warp/heat discoloration, other side a wheel/tire spinning smoothly on a balancer — visually contrasting the two failure modes without text.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots before real generation.

beats.narration: Don't guess. A quick balance check on the machine can find it fast.
beats.visualPrompt: Shop-bay wide shot: a wheel balancing machine mid-cycle, digital readout glowing (numbers illegible/blurred, no readable on-screen text), tools visible but no hands/figures in frame.

beats.narration: Worth checking before it wears on your suspension. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
